title: massive-binary-sim: a physically-traceable simulation framework for a bound pair of massive stars
description: A modular framework for the evolution of a gravitationally bound pair of massive stars (8-150 solar masses each). Every equation is traceable to a cited source; competing physical prescriptions are selectable at runtime; every coefficient is exposed with its literature range. Ships a validation suite against analytic solutions and the Hulse-Taylor pulsar (orbital decay reproduced to 0.02%). The stellar-evolution component uses reduced fitting relations rather than a stellar-structure integration and the binary mass-transfer treatment is heuristic; see KNOWN_GAPS.md. Best suited as a teaching tool and for scoping which physics matters before a detailed population-synthesis run.
